swapInKeepRunningNote: Cooperative signing reduces blockchain space use and improves privacy

swapInSafetyNotes.deposit_refund: This node's key alone can spend a deposit after the refund delay
swapInSafetyNotes.deposit_refund_needs: The recovery secret and this node, or a node restored from its seed
swapInSafetyNotes.deposit_refunds: A deposit that is not swapped can be refunded with any of these once its height is reached, higher fees unlock later
swapInSafetyNotes.htlc_checked: The HTLC was derived here, it locks to the hash of your invoice and refunds to this node
swapInSafetyNotes.htlc_refunds: A swap that is not paid can be refunded with any of these once its height is reached, higher fees unlock later
swapInSafetyNotes.service_claim: The service can only claim the HTLC with the preimage it gets by paying your invoice
swapInSafetyNotes.signing: Signing only lets the service move the deposit into the HTLC

swapOutSafetyNotes.claims: If this stops, broadcast the latest of these whose height is reached until one confirms
swapOutSafetyNotes.claims_shown: near the current fee rate, then at each doubling of the fee rate
swapOutSafetyNotes.locked_payment: The locked payment only settles with a secret made on this node, which it gives out once the swap is funded on chain
swapOutSafetyNotes.not_funded: If the service does not fund the swap on chain, the locked payment times out back to this node
swapOutSafetyNotes.restart: If this stops, use the restart secret with swap-out --recovery to finish the swap
